#

require 'psych'
require 'json'
require 'fluent/config/error'
require 'fluent/config/yaml_parser/fluent_value'

# Based on https://github.com/eagletmt/hako/blob/34cdde06fe8f3aeafd794be830180c3cedfbb4dc/lib/hako/yaml_loader.rb

module Fluent
  module Config
    module YamlParser
      class Loader
        INCLUDE_TAG = 'tag:include'.freeze
        FLUENT_JSON_TAG = 'tag:fluent/json'.freeze
        FLUENT_STR_TAG = 'tag:fluent/s'.freeze
        SHOVEL = '<<'.freeze

        def initialize(context = Kernel.binding)
          @context = context
          @current_path = nil
        end

        # @param [String] path
        # @return [Hash]
        def load(path)
          @current_path = path
          class_loader = Psych::ClassLoader.new
          scanner = Psych::ScalarScanner.new(class_loader)

          visitor = Visitor.new(scanner, class_loader)

          visitor._register_domain(INCLUDE_TAG) do |_, val|
            load(path.parent.join(val))
          end

          visitor._register_domain(FLUENT_JSON_TAG) do |_, val|
            Fluent::Config::YamlParser::FluentValue::JsonValue.new(val)
          end

          visitor._register_domain(FLUENT_STR_TAG) do |_, val|
            Fluent::Config::YamlParser::FluentValue::StringValue.new(val, @context)
          end

          path.open do |f|
            visitor.accept(Psych.parse(f))
          end
        end

        class Visitor < Psych::Visitors::ToRuby
          def initialize(scanner, class_loader)
            super(scanner, class_loader)
          end

          def _register_domain(name, &block)
            @domain_types.merge!({ name => [name, block] })
          end

          def revive_hash(hash, o)
            super(hash, o).tap do |r|
              if r[SHOVEL].is_a?(Hash)
                h2 = {}
                r.each do |k, v|
                  if k == SHOVEL
                    h2.merge!(v)
                  else
                    h2[k] = v
                  end
                end
                r.replace(h2)
              end
            end
          end
        end

        def section_build(parser, name, config, indent: 0, arg: nil)
          interpolation_context = @context
          loaded_path = @current_path
          unless interpolation_context
            path_desc = loaded_path ? loaded_path.to_s : 'yaml'
            raise ArgumentError, "YAML evaluation context is required for #{path_desc}"
          end

          sb = SectionBodyBuilder.new(indent + parser.base_indent)
          bodies = sb.bodies
          indent_text = sb.indent

          if (v = config.delete('$type'))
            bodies << SectionBodyBuilder::Row.new('@type', v, indent_text)
          end

          if (v = config.delete('$label'))
            bodies << SectionBodyBuilder::Row.new('@label', v, indent_text)
          end

          if (v = config.delete('$id'))
            bodies << SectionBodyBuilder::Row.new('@id', v, indent_text)
          end

          config.each do |key, val|
            if val.is_a?(Array)
              val.each do |v|
                bodies << section_build(parser, key, v, indent: indent + parser.base_indent)
              end
            elsif val.is_a?(Hash)
              harg = val.delete('$arg')
              if harg.is_a?(Array)
                # To prevent to generate invalid configuration for arg.
                # "arg" should be String object and concatenated by ","
                # when two or more objects are specified there.
                bodies << section_build(parser, key, val, indent: indent + parser.base_indent, arg: harg&.join(','))
              else
                bodies << section_build(parser, key, val, indent: indent + parser.base_indent, arg: harg)
              end
            else
              bodies << SectionBodyBuilder::Row.new(key, val, indent_text)
            end
          end

          rebuilt = bodies.map do |entry|
            if entry.is_a?(SectionBodyBuilder::Row)
              value = entry.value
              if value.is_a?(FluentValue::StringValue)
                value = FluentValue::StringValue.new(value.val, value.context || interpolation_context)
              end
              SectionBodyBuilder::Row.new(entry.key, value, entry.indent)
            else
              entry
            end
          end
          bodies.replace(rebuilt)

          SectionBuilder.new(name, sb, indent, arg)
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

require_relative 'helper'
require 'fluent/config'
require 'fluent/config/parser'
require 'fluent/supervisor'
require 'fluent/load'
require 'fileutils'

class ConfigTest < Test::Unit::TestCase
  include Fluent

  TMP_DIR = File.dirname(__FILE__) + "/tmp/config#{ENV['TEST_ENV_NUMBER']}"

  def read_config(path, use_yaml: false)
    path = File.expand_path(path)
    if use_yaml
      context = Kernel.binding

      s = Fluent::Config::YamlParser::Loader.new(context).load(Pathname.new(path))
      Fluent::Config::YamlParser::Parser.new(s).build.to_element
    else
      File.open(path) { |io|
        Fluent::Config::Parser.parse(io, File.basename(path), File.dirname(path))
      }
    end
  end

  def prepare_config
    write_config "#{TMP_DIR}/config_test_1.conf", %[
      k1 root_config
      include dir/config_test_2.conf  #
      include #{TMP_DIR}/config_test_4.conf
      include file://#{TMP_DIR}/config_test_5.conf
      <include config.d/*.conf />
    ]
    write_config "#{TMP_DIR}/dir/config_test_2.conf", %[

require 'psych'
require 'json'
require 'fluent/config/error'
require 'fluent/config/yaml_parser/fluent_value'

# Based on https://github.com/eagletmt/hako/blob/34cdde06fe8f3aeafd794be830180c3cedfbb4dc/lib/hako/yaml_loader.rb

module Fluent
  module Config
    module YamlParser
      class Loader
        INCLUDE_TAG = 'tag:include'.freeze
        FLUENT_JSON_TAG = 'tag:fluent/json'.freeze
        FLUENT_STR_TAG = 'tag:fluent/s'.freeze
        SHOVEL = '<<'.freeze

        def initialize(context = Kernel.binding)
          @context = context
          @current_path = nil
        end

        # @param [String] path
        # @return [Hash]
        def load(path)
          class_loader = Psych::ClassLoader.new
          scanner = Psych::ScalarScanner.new(class_loader)

          visitor = Visitor.new(scanner, class_loader)

          visitor._register_domain(INCLUDE_TAG) do |_, val|
            eval_include(Pathname.new(val), path.parent)
          end

          visitor._register_domain(FLUENT_JSON_TAG) do |_, val|
            Fluent::Config::YamlParser::FluentValue::JsonValue.new(val)
          end

          visitor._register_domain(FLUENT_STR_TAG) do |_, val|
            Fluent::Config::YamlParser::FluentValue::StringValue.new(val, @context)
          end

          path.open do |f|
            visitor.accept(Psych.parse(f))
          end
        end

        def eval_include(path, parent)
          if path.relative?
            pattern = parent.join(path)
          else
            pattern = path
          end
          result = []
          Dir.glob(pattern).sort.each do |path|
            result.concat(load(Pathname.new(path)))
          end
          result
        rescue SystemCallError => e
          parse_error = ConfigParseError.new("include error #{path} - #{e}")
          parse_error.set_backtrace(e.backtrace)
          raise parse_error
        end

        class Visitor < Psych::Visitors::ToRuby
          def initialize(scanner, class_loader)
            super(scanner, class_loader)
          end

          def _register_domain(name, &block)
            @domain_types.merge!({ name => [name, block] })
          end

          def revive_hash(hash, o)
            super(hash, o).tap do |r|
              if r[SHOVEL].is_a?(Hash)
                h2 = {}
                r.each do |k, v|
                  if k == SHOVEL
                    h2.merge!(v)
                  else
                    h2[k] = v
                  end
                end
                r.replace(h2)
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

part.text:
Fixed. The `!include` handler in lib/fluent/config/yaml_parser/loader.rb now resolves glob patterns via a new `eval_include` method:

- Relative include paths are resolved against the including file's directory; absolute paths are used as-is.
- `Dir.glob(...).sort` expands wildcards and loads each matching file in deterministic order, concatenating the results (so `!include /path/*.yaml` in a sequence flattens all matched files' sections).
- `SystemCallError` (e.g. missing file) is wrapped in `Fluent::Config::ConfigParseError` with a clear message.

Validation: `test_included`, `test_included_glob`, and `test_check_not_fetchd` in test/test_config.rb all pass; `test/test_supervisor.rb` passes 100%. The single `test_include` failure is pre-existing on the untouched baseline and unrelated to YAML includes.
